outcome: Prevalence of viral pathogens in cerebrospinal fluid (CSF)
cohort: The study included 166 CSF samples from patients hospitalized with suspected viral central nervous system (CNS) infection in Shiraz, Iran.
finding: Of the analyzed CSF samples, 13.3% were positive for a single viral pathogen, with HSV-1 (6.6%) being the most common, followed by SARS-CoV-2 (6 cases).
